source_text: Erigit lapidem in titulum; votum decimarum. Haec Homiliae XII clausula de scala. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Raises stone into monument; vow of-tithes. These of-Homily XII closing about ladder. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[He sets the stone as a pillar >> Bible:Genesis 28:18]] and vows tithes. This is Homily XII’s close on the ladder. Amen.
